data.exact_reserve_text: Change in claims incurred during the year includes positive development on prior accident years of $89.6m (2022 - $56.9m). The positive development was primarily from prior accident year releases on 2017-2022 Weather Related Large Loss Events as well as from the recognition of favourable attritional experience across several classes.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1458 reported a net favourable prior-accident-year development of $89.6m in 2023, representing an approximate 3.86% release of opening gross claims outstanding. Management attributes the improvement primarily to prior accident year releases associated with 2017-2022 weather-related large loss events (notably Hurricane Ian) and to favourable attritional experience across multiple classes, with the effect concentrated in property and casualty lines.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure taken from the narrative sentence under Claims/Claims Outstanding note describing 'positive development on prior accident years of $89.6m'. That sentence sits in the 'change in claims incurred' context. The report also contains a gross claims development triangle which was used as a cross-check; the triangle is present but the movement reconciliation in the notes is not explicitly labelled as 'movement in prior years provision' so the PYD number is taken from the explicit narrative. User should note the distinction between 'claims incurred' and 'movement in provision' in the report; the extracted PYD is therefore given with medium-high confidence (0.8).
